newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arab League to meet over Israel housing plan.
newsitem.headline: Arab League to meet over Israel housing plan.

text.p: The Arab League said on Thursday it would hold an emergency meeting of its permanent representatives on Sunday to discuss Israel's decision to build homes for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem.

Arab League spokesman Tala'at Hamen told Reuters the Palestinian Authority representative had requested the meeting after Israel approved on Wednesday the building of 6,500 houses for Jews in Jabal Abu Ghneim or Har Homa.
"Arab League Secretary General Esmat Abdel-Meguid has said that this decision is dangerous and has negative and dangerous repercussions on the peace process," Hamed said.
Israel's decision has sparked criticism from its key ally the United States and Palestinian warnings that it could unleash bloodshed.
Israel says all of Jerusalem is its capital. Palestinians consider Arab East Jerusalem, which Israel seized during the 1967 Middle East war, the capital of a future Palestinian state.
